title: Did you know? — the Battle of Nuremberg

slides.context: Portugal vs Netherlands, round of 16. Sixteen yellows, *four reds* — the angriest game ever played at this level.
Referee Valentin Ivanov sent four players off. No match on this stage has *come close* since.
Somewhere inside the chaos, Portugal won it with *one clean strike* before half-time.

slides.note: Vera grades discipline daily. Imagine her 2006 file.
